notes: A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. bmdb 1553 (library-ruling consistency pass), mosquitto, b2. EXPORT SURFACE: lib/ is libmosquitto and libcommon is libmosquitto_common, both installed (lib/CMakeLists.txt:129,164, libcommon/CMakeLists.txt:81); the broker target in src/CMakeLists.txt:298 sets ENABLE_EXPORTS, which exports every non-static symbol to the plugins it loads. Every non-static function in these sources therefore has an open caller set (ADR-0011 742a1571, 6b28c8d7), and in-tree call sites prove nothing about a value arriving through its parameters. SELECTION: existing FP labels on non-static functions in exported sources whose recorded reason is caller-side (callers, call sites, contract, precondition, "always valid/never NULL"); tool-only files with their own main() excluded. METHOD: each row read at source by a reviewer; FP -> TP only where the verdict rested solely on callers for a parameter-derived value. Rows with a real in-function basis (a guard present in every build, a null-tolerant callee, a misfire, a value not from a parameter, a language guarantee) or where the keyword match was noise keep FP. assert/DEBUGASSERT/NEVER()/ALWAYS() are not guards (each compiles out or constant-folds in a compilable build). A fresh-context refuter re-checked a random sample of flips and stands. RESULT: 23 rows reviewed, 1 flip FP -> TP here, 22 keep FP. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
